steps.text: Welcome aboard. This walkthrough teaches the cabin, stations and DSKY. Pause with P or wrist PAUSE while reading. Continue acknowledges a note; a step with a live check waits for your action.
Read the commander's FDAI. Find control aims and magnifies on desktop; Esc returns the view. In a headset, Find shows the control's location without turning your head.
Open the wrist menu with M, or the left controller's menu button. It has time controls, SEAT, PAD requests and WALKTHRU.
Use SEAT on the wrist menu to move to CMP, the centre couch. Its DSKY is within reach. M hides the menu on desktop.
On the DSKY, press VERB 1 6 NOUN 2 0 ENTR to monitor the IMU angles. Keyboard: V16N20 then Enter. Verify VERB 16 and NOUN 20 below, then Continue. This changes the display, not the flight program.
The DSKY's VERB says what to do and NOUN says which data. PRO is Space on desktop; Enter is ENTR. Read the current flight checklist before entering a new program.
Use wrist SEAT to move to LEB, the lower equipment bay, where the navigator works the optics and second DSKY.
Find the optics MODE switch. Read its current setting and available positions below. The IMU realign (P52) checklist explains its flight use; leave its setting as it is for this tour.
Use wrist SEAT to return to CDR, the commander's couch.

Choose a flight checklist from the list. The current action, live state and nearby steps stay shared with the cabin card and HUD. F1 chooses a mission/start phase; F5 saves and F9 resumes. P unpauses when you are ready.
